test_cases.path_step: A Teacher starts a live video session by navigating to the 'Sessions' tab in the course details view and clicking the session link.
test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 5: Participating in a Live Class
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Initiates and Participates in Live Video Session
test_cases.pre_condition: The teacher 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' is successfully logged into the system and is on the Course Details Page for the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course. A session titled 'Introduction to Software Testing' for this course, scheduled for 2024-06-15 at 10:00 AM, exists and has been created.
test_cases.expected_result: The teacher successfully starts and joins the live video session. Video and audio streaming are active, and the teacher is able to manage participants and intervention requests. The system displays the video session screen.
test_cases.post_condition: The teacher is participating in the live video session, with video and audio streaming, chat functionality, and intervention controls enabled. The system displays the 'Video Session Screen'.

test_steps.step: Click on the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course list item (link) to navigate to the Course Details Page.
Click the 'Sessions' tab to navigate to the Sessions section.
Click the 'Session Link' next to the 'Introduction to Software Testing' session.
